what: If a line of text fits within the cell width it stays put, and only when it overflows is the same text appended once more so both flow endlessly to the left by their own width (-100%) over 10s linear (1em gap after the text). When the font arrives late or the cell width changes, it re-measures and turns the flow on or off — for lines of varied length like card titles and author lines

options.dur: Length of one loop (seconds), default 10. One set passes in the same time regardless of text length
options.gap: Gap between the two copies (px) — if given, it spaces by this instead of 1em after the text, and overflow is measured with the text width minus the gap
options.rate: Pixels flowing per second — if given, one set passes in (text width + gap) ÷ rate seconds instead of dur (longer text takes longer). smile-days news strip gap: 100; rate: 50

use: A title line here that may be longer than its cell
note: Article child is data-fx-part="text"(if absent, the first child). The clone is aria-hidden. It does not pause on hover (same as the original)

from.where: shared.js header news strip .sd-news__track (original initMarquee(#header_news-container, gap 100, speed 100) — duplicates the text once only when text plus gap is wider than the box, repeats translateX 0→-50% linearly over (text + gap)×2÷100 seconds = 50px per second)
